# jumpcloud_policy_group (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_policy_group" "example" {
  name        = "Compliance Policies"
  description = "All compliance-related device policies"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the policy group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the policy group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_policy_group.example <group-id>
```
